notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p4, Total Governmental Funds); transfers in/out 5,000 printed in the Total column (Flood Disaster to Housing). Business-type from the proprietary statement (p6), which ties to the Statement of Activities (p2); its Loan proceeds 253,079 are printed among nonoperating revenues, so they are a receipt line. Cash: governmental assets are all cash, so ending cash = printed TOTAL ASSETS (p3); beginning cash null (no prior-year column printed). Capital grants have no grantor printed (category other, detail Grants); Other intergovernmental 17,534 is printed as 'Unrestricted state receipts' on p2. Detail: General Fund departmental combining schedule (p9), Street, Housing and Flood Disaster fund schedules (p10-12); Water and Sewer fund columns of the proprietary statement (p6). The all-funds combined budget schedule (p7) is not recorded (overlaps every fund); p8 is the General Fund asset balances by department. Read pages 1-12 of 12 ending_cash left null: no printed cash total (TOTAL ASSETS only), per the 2026-11-06 cash rule; business-type receipts taken from the p6 Total column.
